senses.gloss:
कठ् कठ्, cl. 1. P. कठति, -ठितुम्, to
live in distress.

कठ कठ, अस्, m., N. of a sage, a pupil of
Vaiśampāyana and founder of a branch of the Yajur-
veda, called after him; a Brāhman; a note or simple
sound; (आस्), m. pl. the followers or pupils of Kaṭha;
(ई), f. a female follower of Kaṭha; the wife of a
Brāhman.
—कठ-कालापाः, the schools of Kaṭha
and Kalāpin.
—कठ-कौथुमाः, the schools of
Kaṭha and Kuthumin.
—कठ-धूर्त, अस्, m. a
Brāhman skilled in the Kaṭha branch of the Yajur-
veda.
—कठ-वल्ली or कठवल्ल्य्-उपनिषद्, त्,
or कठ-श्रुति, इस्, or कठोपनिषद् (˚ठ-उप्˚),
त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad consisting of two Adhyāyas
of three Vallī each.
—कठ-शाखा, f. a branch of
the Yajur-veda; also of the Ṛg-veda (?).
—कठ-
शाठ, अस्, m., N. of a man; काठशाठिन्, इनस्,
m. pl., N. of a school.
—कठ-श्रोत्रिय, अस्, m. a
Brāhman who has studied the Kaṭha branch of the
Yajur-veda.
—कठाध्यापक (˚ठ-अध्˚), अस्, m.
a teacher of the Kaṭha branch of the Yajur-veda.
—कठोपनिषद्-भाष्य-टीका, f. a commentary
by Anantānanda on a Kaṭhopaniṣadbhāṣya.
—क-
ठोपनिषद्भाष्यटीका-विवरण, अम्, n. a com-
mentary by Vyāsatīrtha on the last.

काठ काठ, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by Kaṭha;
(अस्), m. a rock, a stone.

कठमर्द कठमर्द, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva; (fr. कठ, distress ? मर्द, dissipating.)

कठर कठर, अस्, आ, अम्, hard; [cf. कठिन
and कठोर.]

कठल्य कठल्य or कठल्ल, अस् or अम्, m.
or n. (?), gravel.

कठाकु कठाकु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
कठ्), a bird (or more probably a particular bird).

कठाहक कठाहक, अस्, m. a gallinule. See
दात्यूह.

कठिका कठिका, f. chalk; the plant com-
monly called Tulasī; [cf. कठिनी and कठिञ्जर.]

कठिञ्जर कठिञ्जर, अस्, m. the tree Ocy-
mum Sanctum, commonly Tulasī.

कठिन कठिन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
कठ्), hard, stiff (opposed to मृदु); inflexible;
violent, as pain; (अस्), m. a thicket; (आ), f. crystal-
ized sugar, a sweetmeat made with refined sugar;
(ई), f. chalk; (अम्), n. an earthen vessel for cooking
(according to some also f.); [cf. Lat. catinum; Gr.
κόφινος]
—कठिन-ता, f. or कठिन-त्व, अम्, n.
hardness, firmness; severity; difficulty, obscurity.
—कठिन-पृष्ठ or कठिन-पृष्ठक, अस्,
m. a tortoise.
—कठिन-हृदय or कठिन-चित्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, hard-hearted, cruel, unkind.
—कठिनान्तः-
करण (˚न-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, harsh, cruel, severe.

काठिन काठिन, अम्, n. (fr. कठिन), hard-
ness, sternness; (अस्), m. the date fruit.
कठिनिका, f. chalk.
कठिनी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, hardened, indurated.

कठिल्ल कठिल्ल, अस्, m. the plant Momordica
Charantia.

कठिल्लक, अस्, m. the plant Momordica Charan-
tia; Ocymum Sanctum [cf. कठिञ्जर]; Bœrhavia
Diffusa.

कठेर कठेर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कठ्),
a needy or distressed man, a pauper.

कठेरणि कठेरणि, इस्, m., N. of a man;
(अयस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man.
कठेरु कठेरु, उस्, m., N. of Kuvera (?).

कठोर कठोर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
कठ्), hard, solid, stiff; offering resistance; sharp,
piercing; severe, cruel, hard-hearted; full, complete,
full-grown; full (as the moon); [cf. कठिन.]
—क-
ठोर-गिरि-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. a portion of the
Brahmāṇḍa-Purāṇa.
—कठोर-ता, f. or कठोर-
त्व, अम्, n. hardness, firmness; severity, rigour.
कठोल, अस्, आ, अम्, resisting, hard, &c., = कठोर.

काठक, अस्, m., N. of a work belonging to the
Brāhmaṇa literature, and derived from the Kaṭha
branch of the Vedas; (अस्, ई, अम्), according to the
Kaṭha portion of the Vedas.

काठशाठिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Kaṭha-
śāṭha.

काठिन्य, अम्, n. hardness, rigidity, stiffness,
sternness, severity; firmness of character; difficulty,
obscurity (of style).
—काठिन्य-फल, अस्, m. the
plant Feronia Elephantum, = कपित्थ.
